name: Cradle Song ~Kinou ni Kanaderu Ashita no Uta~
original_name: くれいどる そんぐ～昨日に奏でる明日の唄～
source:
The city is filled with excited people. There is a legend that "Dragon" defeat monsters that used to live there and saved humans in the long past. The bones of "Dragon" are found and there is a message on them. One day, Tania meets a girl, Rea Teata. She holds a tiny animal, actually it is a child of "Dragon".... Tania starts to feed it with Rea and he starts to find something he lost before....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090302131558/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1004661]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
城里的人们全都兴奋不已。传说在遥远过去，“龙”曾击败栖息于此的怪物，拯救了人类。如今，人们发现了“龙”的遗骨，上面还留着一段信息。一天，塔尼亚遇见少女蕾娅·提亚塔。她怀中抱着一只小动物，而那其实是“龙”的幼崽…塔尼亚开始与蕾娅一同照料它，也渐渐找回自己曾经失去的某样东西…

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090302131558/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1004661]ErogeShop[/url]]
